name: evalship
description: evalship's skills for coding agents: check prompt and model changes, set up evals and act on pull request results.

plugins.name: evalship
plugins.description: Checks whether a change to a prompt, model or LLM call made an AI feature worse beyond chance, sets up evals on every pull request, and acts on evalship's pull request comment.

plugins.name: tinyeval
plugins.description: Checks prompt, model and LLM call changes on real inputs before and after, and keeps those checks as test cases in the repo, with no account.
